Company Information

 

 

Dongguan AOSI Electronics Co.,Ltd 

       Dongguan AOSI Electronics Co., Ltd. is a professional manufacturer of terminals and connectors integrating R&D, production, and sales, with a high-quality management team and technical elites. After nearly 10 years of careful operation, our products have passed certifications such as UL, VDE, CB, CQC, and ROHS, and the factory has obtained ISO9001:2008 quality management system certification.

Dongguan AOSI Electronics Co.,Ltd 

       Dongguan AOSI Electronics Co., Ltd. is a professional manufacturer of terminals and connectors integrating R&D, production, and sales, with a high-quality management team and technical elites. After nearly 10 years of careful operation, our products have passed certifications such as UL, VDE, CB, CQC, and ROHS, and the factory has obtained ISO9001:2008 quality management system certification.
      AOSI covers an area of 15,000 square meters with a building area of 10,000 square meters, employing more than 200 people, including 30 R&D personnel. The company has established a series of core departments, such as R&D center, mold workshop, automatic tapping, and automatic assembly workshop. FAQ

Q2. What about the lead time?

producing large quantity.

 

Q4. How do you ship the goods and how long does it take to arrive?

A: We usually ship by DHL, UPS, FedEx or TNT. It usually takes 3-5 days to arrive. Airline and sea shipping also optional.


Q5.About the delivery time:
A:For regular products, we keep them in stock. We can meet the quickest shipment according to customers’ requirement.

Our Services

Dongguan AOSI Electronics Co.,Ltd 

       Dongguan AOSI Electronics Co., Ltd. is a professional manufacturer of terminals and connectors integrating R&D, production, and sales, with a high-quality management team and technical elites. After nearly 10 years of careful operation, our products have passed certifications such as UL, VDE, CB, CQC, and ROHS, and the factory has obtained ISO9001:2008 quality management system certification.
      AOSI covers an area of 15,000 square meters with a building area of 10,000 square meters, employing more than 200 people, including 30 R&D personnel. The company has established a series of core departments, such as R&D center, mold workshop, automatic tapping, and automatic assembly workshop. The R&D center is equipped with advanced CIMS systems, and the mold workshop is equipped with hundreds of high-precision devices to maintain and enhance the craftsmanship of precision injection molding, stamping, die casting, and cutting.

Our Services

    We are factory direct sales with a wide variety of products, and support customized orders. Some products have not been uploaded in time, and we apologize for any inconvenience. Company Information

 

 

Dongguan AOSI Electronics Co.,Ltd 

       Dongguan AOSI Electronics Co., Ltd. is a professional manufacturer of terminals and connectors integrating R&D, production, and sales, with a high-quality management team and technical elites. After nearly 10 years of careful operation, our products have passed certifications such as UL, VDE, CB, CQC, and ROHS, and the factory has obtained ISO9001:2008 quality management system certification.
      AOSI covers an area of 15,000 square meters with a building area of 10,000 square meters, employing more than 200 people, including 30 R&D personnel. The company has established a series of core departments, such as R&D center, mold workshop, automatic tapping, and automatic assembly workshop. The R&D center is equipped with advanced CIMS systems, and the mold workshop is equipped with hundreds of high-precision devices to maintain and enhance the craftsmanship of precision injection molding, stamping, die casting, and cutting.

FAQ

Q5.About the delivery time:
A:For regular products, we keep them in stock. We can meet the quickest shipment according to customers’ requirement.

 

Q6.Q7: Do you offer guarantee for the products?
A: Yes.

FAQ

 

 

Q1. Can I have a sample order for Terminal blocks?
A: Yes, we welcome sample order to test and check quality. Mixed samples are acceptable.

 

Q2. What about the lead time?
A:Sample needs 1-2 days, mass production time needs 1-2 weeks for order quantity more than 100K pieces

 

Q3.About the payment?
A: The payment terms can be flexiable depend on the quantity and products. We firstly prefer Trade Assurance on alibaba,Another, new customer we prefer the 100% T/T before shipping or 30%T/T advance before

producing large quantity.

 

Q4. How do you ship the goods and how long does it take to arrive?

A: We usually ship by DHL, UPS, FedEx or TNT. It usually takes 3-5 days to arrive. Airline and sea shipping also optional.


Q5.About the delivery time:
A:For regular products, we keep them in stock. We can meet the quickest shipment according to customers’ requirement.

 

Q6.Q7: Do you offer guarantee for the products?
A: Yes.

producing large quantity.

 

Q4. How do you ship the goods and how long does it take to arrive?

A: We usually ship by DHL, UPS, FedEx or TNT. It usually takes 3-5 days to arrive. Airline and sea shipping also optional.


Q5.About the delivery time:
A:For regular products, we keep them in stock. We can meet the quickest shipment according to customers’ requirement.

 

Q6.Q7: Do you offer guarantee for the products?
A: Yes.

description.textDesc:
ABS Material: Durable and lightweight for reliable protection.
Customizable Design: Tailored enclosure fits various 485 Text Screen Controllers.

companyFaqDesc.answers: Yes, we welcome sample order to test and check quality. Mixed samples are acceptable.
companyFaqDesc.question: Can I have a sample order for Terminal blocks?

companyFaqDesc.answers: Sample needs 1-2 days, mass production time needs 1-2 weeks for order quantity more than 100K pieces
companyFaqDesc.question: What about the lead time?

companyFaqDesc.answers: For regular products, we keep them in stock. We can meet the quickest shipment according to customers requirement
companyFaqDesc.question: About the delivery time

companyFaqDesc.answers: Yes
companyFaqDesc.question: Do you offer guarantee for the products?

companyFaqDesc.answers:
The payment terms can be flexiable depend on the quantity and products. We firstly prefer Trade Assurance on alibaba,Another, new customer we prefer the 100% T/T before shipping or 30%T/T advance before

producing large quantity.
companyFaqDesc.question: About the payment?

companyFaqDesc.answers: We usually ship by DHL, UPS, FedEx or TNT. It usually takes 3-5 days to arrive. Airline and sea shipping also optional.

detail.description:
Packaging & Shipping

 

 

 

 

Our Services

 

Company Information

           Dongguan AOSI Electronics Co.,Ltd is the collection       development, production, sales in one of the specialized   terminals,   terminal,  terminal,  connector,   connectors   manufacturers,   and   has   a   number   of  high-quality   management  team  and  technical  elite, through nearly

 ten years of careful management, products through  the

 UL,  VDE,  CB,  CQC,  ROHS  and  other certification, the     factory  has   passed   ISO9001  :  2008  quality  system   certification. The main  products  are: CA series shrapnel   type wiring terminal, CT series lifting type wiring terminal,   CP  series  slide-in  terminals,  CS series screw free press   buckle  type  connection  terminal,  CK series,  CZ  series

 fence  type  wiring terminal  through type wiring terminal,

 a  variety of  single  double  pin  and  IC socket. Standing   specifications  have 2.54, 3.50, 3.81, 3.96, 5, 5.08, 6.35,   7.50, 7.62, 8.255, 9.525, 10, 10.16, 11, 13.00mm.

 

 

 

 

 

FAQ

 

 

Q1. Can I have a sample order for Terminal blocks?
A: Yes, we welcome sample order to test and check quality. Mixed samples are acceptable.

 

Q2. What about the lead time?
A:Sample needs 1-2 days, mass production time needs 1-2 weeks for order quantity more than 100K pieces

 

Q3.About the payment?
A: The payment terms can be flexiable depend on the quantity and products. We firstly prefer Trade Assurance on alibaba,Another, new customer we prefer the 100% T/T before shipping or 30%T/T advance before

producing large quantity.

 

Q4. How do you ship the goods and how long does it take to arrive?

A: We usually ship by DHL, UPS, FedEx or TNT. It usually takes 3-5 days to arrive. Airline and sea shipping also optional.


Q5.About the delivery time:
A:For regular products, we keep them in stock. We can meet the quickest shipment according to customers’ requirement.

 

Q6.Q7: Do you offer guarantee for the products?
A: Yes.

Q5.About the delivery time:
A:For regular products, we keep them in stock. We can meet the quickest shipment according to customers’ requirement.

 

Q6.Q7: Do you offer guarantee for the products?
A: Yes.

item.description:
Бесконтактный модуль твердотельного реле / усилитель дискретных сигналов ZS-DO-M (Zhongsheng Technology).

Заменяет промежуточное электромагнитное реле: нет механических контактов, нет искрения и залипания, высокий ресурс и быстрый отклик. Подходит для шкафов автоматики, станков, IoT и лабораторных стендов.

▸ Ключевые характеристики
• Модель: ZS-DO-M
• Каналы: 4 / 8 / 12 / 16 (выберите нужный SKU)
• Управление: 3–9 В DC или 10–30 В DC
• Тип выхода: NPN (низкий уровень) или PNP (высокий уровень)
• Выход: 5–30 В DC, до 3 А на канал
• Входной ток: 5–10 мА
• Силовые элементы: MOSFET (P/N-канал)
• Изоляция: оптопара (гальваническая развязка)
• Совместимость входов: NPN/PNP сигналы PLC, датчиков, Arduino / STM32 / ESP32
• Монтаж: DIN-рейка 35 мм, съёмные винтовые клеммы
• Индикация: статус каждого канала
• Производство: Китай, Dongguan; ISO9001, CE
• Гарантия: 5 лет

▸ Преимущества
• Защита контроллера от помех и перенапряжений
• Прямое управление электромагнитными клапанами и индуктивной нагрузкой
• Стабильная работа в промышленном шкафу
• Удобная маркировка клемм X/Y, VCC/GND

▸ Применение
Расширение DO PLC, усиление выходов MCU, управление соленоидами, клапанами, контакторами, сигнальными цепями автоматики.

▸ Комплектация
Модуль ZS-DO-M — 1 шт. (выбранная конфигурация каналов/напряжения/типа выхода).

▸ Как выбрать SKU
1) Число каналов: 4 / 8 / 12 / 16
2) Управляющее напряжение: 3–9 В или 10–30 В DC
3) Тип выхода: NPN или PNP
Сверьте схему подключения NPN/PNP в карточных изображениях перед заказом.

attributes.description: 无包装产品的重量（净）克每1SKU。 您只能指定整数或十进制数。 分隔符是一个点

attributes.name: 保证
attributes.description: 制造商对产品质量负责的期间。 并且买方可以申请保修案件的退款。 从下拉列表中选择一个值。

attributes.name: 组合成类似的产品
attributes.description: 在此属性中输入相同的值以将产品组合到"类似"组中。 请注意，组内的产品是在个人帐户内第二级的同一类别内收集的。 如果产品具有相同的组名称，但它们属于不同的类别，您将收到多个产品组合。 有关组合成类似产品的详细信息，请参阅知识库中"类似产品"一文

attributes.name: 防护等级
attributes.description: 请从列表中选择或手动输入。您可以添加多个值，并以分号（；）来分隔。如果属性值中包含分号，那么请将该符号置于双引号中（如“；”）。

attributes.name: 臭氧。视频背景：链接
attributes.description: 指定视频（MP4，MOV）的链接。 持续时间从8到30秒，文件大小不超过20MB

attributes.name: 臭氧。视频：标题
attributes.description: 为视频指定名称

attributes.name: 配套
attributes.description: 列出产品中包含的内容：说明，案例，一套电线等。 不要复制其他特征（包中的注释、类型或数量）的值。 如果您正在交付没有额外包裹的物品，请不要填写此说明。

attributes.name: 统一计量单位中的商品数量
attributes.description: UEI是一个统一的计量单位。 必须根据当地立法规定在白俄罗斯共和国领土上销售货物。 表示每个SKU的件数。 您只能指定一个整数。

attributes.name: 名称
attributes.description: 名称是按照原则写的：类型+品牌+型号（系列+解释）+制造商的文章+，（逗号）+名称属性不是用大写字母写的（我们不使用caps lock）。 在属性之前放置逗号。 如果有几个属性，它们也用逗号分隔。 如果名称中没有任何部分，请跳过它。 属性可以是：颜色，重量，体积，包装中的件数等。 颜色是用一个小字母写成的，用阳刚的，单数的。 我们不把颜色这个词写在名字里。 最后没有点。 除逗号外，我们不使用任何标点符号。 我们只在俄语中使用引号. 正确名称的例子：Apple iPhone XS MT572RU/a智能手机，space black Dr.Martens经典运动鞋，白色和黑色，尺寸43Ariel Magic white洗涤剂带量勺，15公斤Heinz Xtreme Tabasco超快酱，10毫升动物玩具四爪"跑鼠"BMM，白

attributes.name: 型号名称（针对合并为一张商品卡片）
attributes.description: 在该字段中填写要合并的产品的任何相同值。 并以不同的方式，如果货物需要分开。 如果产品具有相同的类型和品牌，并且在组合中的所有产品上不同地填充至少一个可变特征，则将发生组合。

attributes.name: #主题标签
attributes.description: 主题标签的工作方式与社交网络中的工作方式相同：客户可以在卡中单击它们或在搜索中写入。 在此处指定趋势、样式或主题。 例如，对于衣服#oldmoney#kpop#boho，对于家具#斯堪的纳维亚风格#极简主义#loft。 请勿添加品牌、参数或产品名称。  标签必须以#号开头，并且只包含字母和数字。 如果主题标签由2+个单词组成，请用下划线连接它们。 最大长度为30个字符。 指定不超过30个主题标签，用空格分隔

attributes.name: 含包装重量，克
attributes.description: 您只能指定整数或小数。分隔符是一个句点。

attributes.name: 类型
attributes.description: 从列表中选择最合适的产品类型。 这些类型参与了Ozon网站上的产品分类。 要正确指定类型，请在Ozon网站上找到与您相似的产品，并在此字段中指定相同的类型。

attributes.name: 批次号
attributes.description: 唯一标识产品或部件的唯一代码。 您可以根据制造商的非原装备件目录添加零件编号。 如果部件没有这样的物品，请在此处指定卖方代码。

attributes.name: 品牌
attributes.description: 生产产品的品牌名称。 如果产品没有品牌，请使用"无品牌"值。

attributes.name: JSON富内容
attributes.description: 使用JSON格式的模板添加带有照片和视频的扩展产品描述。 有关填写此特征的详细信息，请参阅知识库中的文章"丰富内容"。

attributes.name: 原厂包装数量
attributes.description:
你在这个SKU下销售多少个工厂包？ 示例：24罐婴儿泥在工厂密封在1包装中，并在其他商店以相同的形式出售—指定值1。
另一个例子：工厂以1或10件的包装生产灯泡，您决定出售3个灯泡并将其密封在一个包装中—属性值将为3

attributes.name: 需要标记代码
attributes.description: 如果产品有标记代码(KIZ)，请选择"是"。 我们将在每次装运或交货时检查它。 通过Seller API集成时，将参数传递为"true"

attributes.name: 臭氧。视频：链接
attributes.description: 指定视频（MP4，MOV）的链接。 持续时间从8秒到5分钟，文件大小不超过2GB

attributes.name: 臭氧。视频：视频产品
attributes.description: 指定视频中显示的产品。 列出以逗号分隔的SKU（不超过5）。

attributes.name: 欧亚经济联盟的HS编码
attributes.description: 从列表中选择一个值。 如果您不知道指定哪个代码，则需要联系海关服务或海关代表。

attributes.name: 原产国
attributes.description: 产品制造/组装的国家，并在包装上注明。 它可能与品牌所在的国家/地区不同。 从列表中选择或手动指定。 您可以添加多个以分号分隔的值。
